module: Node "Get Custom Vehicle Value" (`duration`, `once` behavior). Evaluates on the vehicle side a Lua expression (`data.fun`, for example `electrics.values.ignition` or `electrics.values.hazard_enabled`, chosen from a list or custom) and returns the result via `obj:queueGameEngineLua` to `returnValue`. Input pins: `flow`, `reset`, `VehId`; outputs: `flow` (when the value has arrived, with a delay of a few frames), `value` (any), `valBool` (bool: value ~= 0 if number, otherwise nil).
notes: The input pin is named `VehId` (capital) but the code reads `self.pinIn.vehId`: the chosen vehicle is therefore ignored and the player vehicle is used.
The expression is inserted as is into a Lua command: do not feed it with an untrusted source.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Dropdown list of predefined functions and text field for a custom function.

getCmd.desc: Builds the Lua command sent to the vehicle.

init.desc: Constructor; `data.fun` = first function of the list.

returnValue.desc: Called back by the vehicle VM with the serialized value; deserializes it into `returnedValue`.

value.desc: Serialized value returned by the vehicle VM.

work.desc: Sends the command to the vehicle once, then exposes `value`/`valBool` upon reception.
